en: A black‑and‑white, scallop‑edged postcard showing the lavish high altar of a Baroque church interior. The composition centers on a tall altarpiece framed by dramatic sculpted figures, swirling stucco and gilded ornamentation, with a painting in the middle, an ornate tabernacle below, and a bright domed window or oculus above. Wooden communion rails and pews appear in the foreground.
